study type: Unmatched case-control study with retrospective chart review
cohort: The study included 261 newborn babies (87 COVID positive cases and 174 COVID negative controls) born to mothers who were COVID positive within 14 days before delivery at a dedicated tertiary care COVID treatment hospital.
finding: The significant risk factors associated with neonatal COVID positivity were Prolonged Rupture of Membrane during delivery, Meconium stained amniotic fluid, and Preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not show a significant association with neonatal COVID positivity.
followup_time: 24 to 48 hours after birth (for COVID testing)
